qa.verdict: PASS — all 18 acceptance criteria verified via live browser DevTools measurement at 1440x900 (desktop) and 390px (mobile). Zero blocking findings.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex reviewed the prior BA-QA report (ba-qa-report-20260517-153318.json) which identified 6 blocking defects in the BA spec AC wording (BF1-BF6: unscoped querySelector in AC14, wrong .tab-content selector in AC8, getComputedStyle not exposing custom properties in AC2, hidden .slot-selected in AC15, missing mobile AC17/AC18). Codex confirmed these were pre-dev spec defects that needed fixing before implementation. However, the ticket as received already incorporated AC17 and AC18, and QA's live verification queries already used the corrected, hardened selectors throughout — so none of the BF1-BF6 concerns affect the live verification performed here.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Confirmed all Codex BF1-BF6 concerns are addressed in my verification: AC14 used '#timeline-slots > .slot + .slot' (scoped); AC8 used '#tab-timeline' directly (not '.tab-content'); AC2 used cs.getPropertyValue('--bg-page') (custom property API); AC15 used '.slot-selected:not([hidden])' (visible only); AC17/AC18 exist in ticket and were both tested at 390px. No revision to verdict required.

observations.detail: Codex (via ba-qa-report context) suggested a timezone-controlled AC to verify UTC date parsing correctness by running DevTools in America/Los_Angeles timezone. Classified observation_only: _formatDayHeadingDate() uses Date.UTC + Intl.DateTimeFormat(timeZone:'UTC') per Technical Hints — the implementation recipe is fully specified. Timezone-controlled Playwright emulation is disproportionate overhead for this verification scope.

Codex noted that AC10 could additionally assert document.querySelector('#timeline-slots').children[0].tagName === 'H2' as an alternative to the CSS selector. Not required — isFirstChild:true was verified explicitly in addition to the CSS selector.
